system.description: An initiate's power: the adept's Centering may reduce the penalties on tests in one more skill category (Build/Repair, Combat, Knowledge, Language, Magical, Social, Technical or Vehicle) or one Special Skill. Buy it once per category.
system.notes: Cost 2 per skill category, 1 per Special Skill. Needs the Centering metamagic. Magical skills stay mundane (no spellcasting). Grimoire p.34.
